title: Direct ChatOllama.bind_tools probe (no agent, no ATP): qwen emits tool-call JSON as plain text; llama emits structured but truncated calls
environment: Developer Mac (darwin), local Ollama at loopback; isolated local harness: disposable Docker PostgreSQL + Fastify listener mounting the Studio mandate SQL route. Not a Studio deployment.

output: llama3.2:3b tc=sql_db_query: tool_calls=[{'name': 'sql_db_query', 'args': {'query': 'SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE country = '}, 'id': '2fd45b3d-f1e6-410d-860d-3a29167bf6e9', 'type': 'tool_call'}] content_head=''

llama3.2:3b tc=any: tool_calls=[{'name': 'sql_db_query', 'args': {'query': 'SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE country = '}, 'id': 'a1b8d572-614f-4e40-b75d-1f0193e1af61', 'type': 'tool_call'}] content_head=''

llama3.2:3b tc=required: tool_calls=[{'name': 'sql_db_query', 'args': {'query': 'SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE country = '}, 'id': '9f226b8e-6278-417b-9b08-f2ade7c1efff', 'type': 'tool_call'}] content_head=''

notes: Model-capability probe only. No ATP server involved; demonstrates qwen2.5-coder:7b returns tool_calls=[] with the call serialized as JSON in content, under tool_choice=sql_db_query/any/required.
